title: Compute brief - 24 November 2026
description: Enforcement follows the rule: BIS blacklisted seven Megaspeed-linked firms in Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand, Spain's data centre decree took effect, and Apollo and Goldman priced $44 billion of debt to buy Vera Rubin GPUs for SpaceX. Wire: Megaspeed Entity List, SpaceX GPU financing, Spain RD 1032/2026, TSMC Brazos 2nm filing, TSMC no order changes, Thailand NTT/B.Grimm 400 MW, India CtrlS Bihar, Latvia Salaspils. Tape: 70 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW.
og_kicker: The rule gets names: Megaspeed is blacklisted.
lede: The BIS remote-access rule now has named targets. On 23 November Commerce filed a final rule adding seven Megaspeed-linked companies in Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand to the Entity List, with all EAR items licensed under a presumption of denial, and Malaysia told its data centre operators not to host or serve them. Capital is still pricing compute as an asset class: Apollo and Goldman priced about $44 billion of notes to buy Nvidia Vera Rubin systems for SpaceX, the largest GPU financing yet, with lease schedules starting in the first half of 2027. Spain's Royal Decree 1032/2026 took effect on 22 November, tying grid access for data centres to 80 per cent hourly-matched new renewables and curtailment duties, and TSMC filed for a possible 2nm fab in Brazos County, Texas, while saying no customer has changed orders. List prices held for a twelfth straight trading day: 70 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW, with Lambda H100 at $4.59 and B200 at $7.69.
